$comment: Split profile. The heavy reasoning roles run on Muse Spark 1.3 because it is the strongest free model on Zen by a wide margin (Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.8% vs Nemotron 3 Ultra's 56.4%, DeepSWE v1.1 75.4%). The bulk-output roles stay on Space Bunny because its 524,288-token output cap is 4x Muse Spark's 131,072, and scaffolding or migrating many files is where that ceiling is actually felt. `retention` below describes the BASE model only; the config header prints the effective retention, which is may-train because three roles run on Muse Spark. `oc-harness use` reads the whole set of models in play, not this field, so it warns and wants --yes because of the split roles even though the base says zero-retention.
title: Muse Spark 1.3 (heavy) + Space Bunny Free (bulk output)
notes: Opt-in split, not a default. Muse Spark is a Meta contributor-tier free endpoint: its provider may train on your prompts and completions. Three of the five roles are therefore may-train even though the base model is zero-retention. Install it only for public or throwaway repositories. Effort requests below are resolved against each role's own model, so plan and reviewer ask for `max` and land on `xhigh`, which is the top Muse Spark offers.
